NONE: › If an aircraft or ship yaws, it moves slightly to the side of its intended direction.
B1 to open the mouth wide and take a lot of air into the lungs and slowly send it out, usually when tired or bored

C: › something or someone that is very boring

example: I can't stop yawning - I must be tired.
我不停打哈欠——肯定是累了。
Her eyes watered as she tried to stifle (= stop) a yawn.
她強忍著不打哈欠，眼淚都出來了。
The film was a total yawn.

NONE: › used to describe a difference or amount that is extremely large and difficult to reduce
（差異或數量）巨大的，難以縮減的
› A yawning space or hole is very wide.

example: There exists nowadays a yawning gap between rich and poor.
如今貧富之間存在巨大的差異。
